evidence.reason: The finding describes an unbounded blocking `sys.stdin.buffer.read(64 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)` with no input deadline. At the pinned tip, `apps/crq-python/signer/spool-shell` instead defines `INPUT_DEADLINE_S = 300` and reads via `read_bundle`, which loops with `select.select([fd], [], [], remaining)` against a `time.monotonic()` deadline and raises `ValueError('ledger bundle input deadline exceeded')` when the deadline passes or no data is ready. The bundle size cap is preserved (`while len(body) <= limit`, `min(_READ_CHUNK, limit + 1 - len(body))`). The history line attributes this change to commit 128030e1cdc1521c1ca8222edee0f56f31c4d999 ("fix(review): bound spool-shell bundle read with input deadline"), so the reported defect no longer exists at the current tip.
